title: Chinese Streaming Service iQIYI Has Subscription Revenue Opportunity, Oppenheimer Says In Bullish Initiation
主要内容: Oppenheimer analyst Bo Pei initiated coverage of iQIYI with an Outperform rating and a $23 price target. iQIYI has over 450 million monthly average users and more than 105 million paying subscribers. A survey by Oppenheimer indicated that 65% of respondents are willing to pay more for video streaming subscriptions. Pei noted that iQIYI may see strong subscriber additions in Q1 2020 due to increased viewership from the coronavirus outbreak in China. While online advertising may face delays or cancellations of marketing campaigns, these impacts are temporary. Content cost as a percentage of revenue is expected to decline from 77% in 2019 to 70% in 2020 and 60% in 2021, improving margins. iQIYI shares were trading at $17.94, up 2.93% at the time of publication. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include iQIYI Inc (IQ).
